title: Dimension theory of group actions by circle diffeomorphisms I: Stationary measures
summary: We establish a structure theorem for smooth random walks on the circle and study the dimensional properties of their stationary measures, including exact dimensionality and a Ledrappier-Young-type dimension formula. These results provide the technical tools needed for the main theorems in Part II "Dimension theory of group actions by circle diffeomorphisms II: Minimal sets".
